notes.title: DROPTCH - Content Roadmap (Version Beach)
notes.notes:
Greetings Stranded,

The following features and mechanics are planned for [b]Version Beach[/b]. This list will be updated at a later date and all time estimates are subject to change.

[h3]SEPTEMBER:[/h3]

[list]
[*] More Tools: The ability to FORGE tools and manipulate more of your surroundings
[*]  [strike] Crab Pots: Once constructed, these will allow for the capture of seafood, which in turn, will bolster FOOD supplies [/strike]
[*] [strike] Support Posts: Using BUNDLES, various structures can be built at these points, such as bridges, landmarks and other labor-saving constructs [/strike]
[*] [strike] Rocks: Allows for gathering of STONE [/strike]
[*] Gas Lamp: A portable, refuellable light source
[*] [strike] Bamboo: A lightweight, flexible BUNDLE [/strike]
[*] Buckets: Constructed from BUNDLES, these have a multitude of uses
[/list]

[h3]OCTOBER:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Inventory Tome: Allows for full Inventory management
[*] Sea Chest: Store resources and put them aside for personal use
[*] Weather Vane: [spoiler] Keep track of the Winds of Fate (daily luck) [/spoiler]
[*] [strike] More Isles: A greater number of randomly generated landmass features and biomes [/strike]
[*] Ladders: Constructed using BUNDLES, allowing for vertical exploration
[*] Buoy: A beacon for other players to sail to and leave resources at
[*] Workbench: Allows for refining of BUNDLES
[*] Shipwrecks: Rare in-game events that can be explored for unique resources and permanent upgrades
[/list]

[h3]NOVEMBER:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Shelters: Spend resources towards the construction of your home
[*] Underground Grottos:  [spoiler] Rare, explorable caves with mysterious, ancient ruins [/spoiler]
[*] Weather: More weather types, such as typhoons and heavy rain
[*] Cataloging: Record and study local flora and fauna
[*] Agriculture Suite: Sow, grow and harvest your own FOOD
[*] Mail Raft: Send and receive direct messages from other STRANDED
[*] Stove: Prepare FOOD resources
[*] Ores: Smelting and construction resources
[*] Experimental VR Branch: DROPTCH gameplay support for VR devices (platforms to be determined)
[*] Experimental Ray Tracing Branch: DROPTCH gameplay utilizing ray tracing technology
[/list]

[h3]UPCOMING QUALITY IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [strike] Foliage Animations [/strike]
[*] Cloud System
[*] [strike] Wind Direction Particles [/strike]
[*] Wild Grasses
[*] Wildlife
[*] Full Controller Support: DirectInput devices with support for feedback (vibration)
[*] [strike] Ultra-wide Support [/strike]
[*] Multi-language Support
[*] Multi-platform Support
[*] Steam Workshop Integration
[/list]

THE [b]GREAT DIVINE[/b] IS ALWAYS WATCHING...
